Standing at {{height|ft=6|in=1}}, he plays at the [[point guard]] and [[shooting guard]] positions. He played parts of two seasons in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), and three seasons in the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].{{Cite web|url=https://basket.co.il/player.asp?PlayerId=9154&lang=en|title=ISRAEL BASKETBALL SUPER LEAGUE | Israel Basketball | 2010-11 Season | Hapoel Migdal Jerusalem | Will Solomon|website=basket.co.il}} ==Amateur career== Solomon was first noticed at [[East Hartford High School]] in [[East Hartford, Connecticut]]. He held several records and is in several clubs in their schools basketball program, such as "1000 Career Points", "All State", "All Conference", and the only member of the "NBA Draft" club. He went to [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]] where he continued his basketball career. He was named first-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC) as a junior, and made the second team as a senior. ==Professional career== Solomon declared himself eligible for the [[2001 NBA draft]] after his junior year at [[Clemson University]]. He was selected by the [[Vancouver Grizzlies]] in the second round, with the 32nd overall pick. Solomon played for the Grizzlies in the [[2001-02 NBA season|2001–02 season]] and averaged 5.2 points, 1.5 assists and 1.1 rebounds over 62 games. After only one year in the NBA, Solomon decided to move to Europe and signed a contract with the Greek team [[Aris BC|Aris Thessaloniki]] in 2003. That year he won the [[FIBA EuroCup Challenge]], 4th-tier European competition. After a year in [[Greece]], Solomon moved to [[Israel]] and played for [[Hapoel Jerusalem B.C.|Hapoel Jerusalem]], with whom he won another European title, the [[ULEB Cup]], 2nd-tier European competition. In Israel, he was often nicknamed "The Fish" (Ha-dag, הדג), as in Hebrew his last name resembles "[[Salmon]]" much more than [[King Solomon]], which is pronounced "Shlomo." For 2004–05, he moved to [[Turkey]] and was signed by [[Efes Pilsen S.K.|Efes Pilsen]]. He then played for the first time in his career in the [[EuroLeague]]. With the help of Solomon, [[Efes Pilsen S.K.|Efes Pilsen]] won the [[Turkish Basketball League|Turkish championship]] that year. Solomon moved back to Israel the following season and was signed by [[Maccabi Tel Aviv B.C.|Maccabi Tel Aviv]], who were the European champions the previous two seasons and were close to winning a third consecutive EuroLeague title before losing in the final. After this, he returned to [[Istanbul]] and joined [[Fenerbahçe Men's Basketball|Fenerbahçe]], that enjoyed a high budget and a [[EuroLeague]] spot after the [[Ülker|Ülker Food Group]] decided to close their own team and move their entire support of funds and players to [[Fenerbahçe Men's Basketball|Fenerbahçe Ülker]]'s basketball team. Nicknamed 'King Solomon'{{Cite web|url=https://www.milliyet.com.tr/yazarlar/|title=Yazarlar|website=Milliyet}} by the Fenerbahçe fans, he helped the team win two championships. Solomon also played [[point guard]] for the [[Washington Wizards]] summer league team in [[Las Vegas, Nevada|Las Vegas]] during the NBA's off-season in 2006. On July 28, 2008, Solomon was signed by the [[Toronto Raptors]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/solomonrelease_072808.html|title=Raptors Sign Free Agent Will Solomon|website=Toronto Raptors}} On February 19, 2009, Solomon was traded to the [[Sacramento Kings]] in a three-team deal that sent [[Patrick O'Bryant]] to the Raptors from the [[Boston Celtics]] and a conditional second round pick in 2014 to the Celtics.{{cite press release |title = KINGS ACQUIRE WILL SOLOMON IN THREE-TEAM TRADE |publisher = Sacramento Kings |date = 2009-02-19 |url = http://www.nba.com/kings/news/press_release_021909_2.html |access-date = 2009-02-20}} Shortly after being traded to the [[Sacramento Kings]], Will Solomon was waived.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/espn/wire/_/section/nba/id/4055103|title=Kings waive G Will Solomon|website=ESPN.com}} Solomon's final NBA game was played on April 3, 2009, in a 111 - 139 loss to the Phoenix Suns where Solomon recorded no stats in 3 minutes of playing time. On April 9, 2009, the Turkish champions [[Fenerbahçe Men's Basketball|Fenerbahçe]] reached an agreement with him in order to bring him back to his former team,{{Cite web|url=http://www.fenerbahce.org/anasayfa/anasayfa-abtest|title=Anasayfa - Fenerbahçe SK|website=www.fenerbahce.org}} but he was released from his contract on November 7, 2009. In August 2010, he returned to Israel and signed a one-year contract with pro club [[Hapoel Jerusalem B.C.|Hapoel Jerusalem]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/item/74737|title=Hapoel Jerusalem brings back Solomon|website=Welcome to 7DAYS EuroCup|date=27 June 2023 }}{{dead link|date=February 2023|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}} In the summer of 2011, he signed a contract with the [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] team [[Cherkaski Mavpy]]. In October 2012, he signed a contract with [[Mersin Büyükşehir Belediyesi S.K.|Mersin BB]] of the [[Turkish Basketball League]] for the 2012–13 season. In November 2013, he signed with the French team [[Olympique Antibes|Shark Antibes]].{{cite web|title=Will Solomon pigiste médical de Trevor
